---
title: "The Architecture of Apostasy"
subtitle: "A collective archive of theological discussion, images, songs, and essays"
---

This archive gathers theological writing, visual material, drafts, and future song or discussion resources into a public-facing library.

The project currently centers on corrupted worship, institutional religion, sacred time, embodied disorder, political liturgy, and the deeper cosmological conflict behind the inversion of the Imago Dei.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This site is organized for general readers. The Markdown pages are reading copies; the `raw/` folder preserves source PDFs, original drafts, and OCR output.
:::
